title: Scout Resewn
description: Retextures Scout Recrafted's item and model textures.
body:
Retextures [Scout Recrafted](https://modrinth.com/mod/scout-recrafted)'s item and model textures into something a little more my tastes. 

Satchel strap mapping based off [Scout Recrafted Modernized](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/scout-recrafted-modernized) but otherwise everything is original. 

Should work on other versions and could possibly work on other Scout forks?
